Advanced Energy Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 This study resolves the multiscale structural origin of O₂ release in practical Li-Mn-rich electrodes, showing it is not electrode- or particle-scale heterogeneity but grain frontal-facet exposure that governs oxygen loss. By mapping Mn reduction across four orders of magnitude, it identifies frontal-facet area as a key descriptor, providing a design principle for mitigating gas evolution in high-energy-density cathodes.

item.title: Amorphous Halide Cathodes Enable 75C All-Solid-State Lithium Batteries
item.description:
این مقاله با آمورف‌سازی LiVCl4 و کاهش موانع مرزدانه‌ای، کاتد هالیدی بدون الکترولیت را قادر می‌سازد در باتری تمام‌جامد لیتیومی به نرخ فوق‌سریع 75C و پایداری 16000 چرخه دست یابد.
Journal of the American Chemical Society | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Amorphizing halide cathodes (LiVCl4, LiTaOCl4) minimizes grain-boundary ion-transport barriers rather than maximizing bulk conductivity, enabling catholyte-free ASSLBs with 90 wt% CAM. This yields 75C operation (102.1 mAh g–1 at 20 mA cm–2), 16,000-cycle stability, and wide-temperature performance, establishing conformal amorphous interfaces as a new paradigm for ultrahigh-power all-solid-state lithium batteries.
🏷 all-solid-state lithium battery · halide cathode · amorphous LiVCl4 · grain boundary · ultrafast charging
